items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Asimov. Asimov, yeah. Asimov, well all they, parade. Every year they had the parade.

ctx.x: I've seen some of them got nice now too. Yeah, they had in yellow, no yellow suits out there, Miss Patterson. And I'll tell you, they could drill. I used to play, they used to play with, you reckon, used to play for them all the time.

Yeah. Now you take, my cousin, she died there. She was a good driller. Asimov. Asimov, yeah. Asimov, well all they, parade. Every year they had the parade. Oh yeah, every year. Every year they had the parade. Every year they had the parade. Like the Eagle Eyes, the old fellas, the boys. Well that's over here. Yeah. The young men, well all them had the, you see that? The Rika, the Rika Society, you know the Rika Society? Yeah, yeah, the Rika, yeah. Where's that? I believe the Rika Society, it's over here. No, the…
You see, you see, you see, Willock Parker. Willock Parker, yeah.
